explanation: Two bodies at rest 1.0 apart should receive equal-opposite impulses, keeping total px=0 and L=0. At step 1 the 20-mass body has vx=+0.136 (impulse +2.72) while the 1-mass body has vx=-3.02 (impulse -3.02), net px=-0.302. With both at y=6, L=-y*px=+1.81 vs allowed 0.07. Likely cause is asymmetric force application within the step (e.g. per-body substep counts: substeps_in_step=12, or sequential Gauss-Seidel style updates) so kicks are not equal-opposite.
